category_definitions.measure: approximate asymptotic power at 5% of the nominal h=12 adjusted Portmanteau against the population residual autocorrelation of the pseudo-true (population least-squares) VAR(1), noncentrality n * sum_j tr(C_j' C_0^-1 C_j C_0^-1)
category_definitions.note: design-level property of (DGP, T); correct and over-selected models are correctly specified
